claims.text: The Tongan release states that the Prince Regent ('Tama Tui Fakaleo' as printed [Tama Tu'i Fakaleo]), Crown Prince 'Tupoutoa' as printed [Tupouto'a], on Saturday ('Tokonaki') 11 Fepueli 2006 accepted the letter of the Prime Minister, Prince Ulukalala Lavaka Ata, to retire ('malolo' as printed [mālōlō]) from his office as Palemia of Tonga and from his ministerial portfolios. On the same 11 February the Prince Regent appointed Hon. Dr. Feleti Sevele as 'Palemia Leoleo' as printed [Palēmia Le'ole'o] (Acting Prime Minister).
claims.uncertainty: The English rendering is this packet's reading. The archived capture drops macrons and glottal stops; quoted words are given as printed with the normalised spelling in brackets. The Tongan text says 'malolo' (retire) where the English release says 'resignation'; both date the acceptance to 11 February 2006.
